title: Doctor
intro: Checks what Shrinkerr depends on. Reporting a problem? Attach the diagnostics file — passwords, API keys and tokens are taken out.

media_folder.title: Media folders
media_folder.missing: Not found — is the drive or share mounted?
media_folder.unreadable: Can't be read — check its permissions.
media_folder.readonly: Read-only — Shrinkerr can't replace files here. Check the mount and the container's user (PUID/PGID).
media_folder.timeout: Didn't answer within 15 seconds — the network share may be stalled.
media_folder.low_space: Only {{free}} free (below your {{threshold}} warning) — a conversion writes the new file next to the original.
media_folder.none: No media folders yet — add one in Settings → Media.

data_folder.title: Data folder
data_folder.readonly: Not writable — Shrinkerr can't save its database or settings.
data_folder.low_space: Only {{free}} free — the database and its backups need room.

database.title: Database
database.error: The integrity check failed ({{detail}}) — restore a backup from Settings → System.

vmaf.title: VMAF
vmaf.info: Not in this ffmpeg build — VMAF checks are skipped.

encoder.title: Encoder
encoder.missing: {{encoder}}, your default, isn't available here. Available: {{available}} — pick one in Settings → Video.

connection.noKey: No API key — posters and original languages can't be looked up.

auth.title: Password
auth.info: Not set — anyone on your network can use Shrinkerr. Set one in Settings → System.
